# rustinion_group_terminal_services (Resource)

Manages a group's expected terminal services: products that give people a shell through the browser on purpose (ttyd, GoTTY, WeTTY, code-server, JupyterLab terminals, the OOPS! lab agent). A shell started under a process matching an entry by program path and arguments is recorded as info and never alerts; any other program starting a shell still alerts. Nothing is expected by default. Destroying this resource clears the list.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The group these settings belong to.

### Optional

- `builtins` (List of String) Built-in suggestions to expect: `ttyd`, `gotty`, `wetty`, `code-server`, `jupyter`, `oops-agent` (the OOPS! browser-terminal agent, `*/node` running `/opt/oops-agent/agent.js`). Default none.
- `custom` (Attributes List) Your own entries (at most 50 in total). An entry for a general-purpose runtime or shell (node, python, bash...) must name the script in `args`; a program pattern matching everything is refused. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as group_id.

<a id="nestedatt--custom"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom`

Required:

- `args` (String) Glob over the program's arguments joined by spaces, e.g. `/srv/term/server.js`; `*` for any.
- `exe` (String) Glob over the program's path (`*` matches anything), e.g. `*/node`.
- `name` (String) What the device page calls it.
